description: Opaque rust-burgundy floor-length court dress with a low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. A fitted structured bodice is decorated with gold floral and geometric embroidery. Broad gold patterned borders run down the front, around the cuffs and hem. A cream underlayer shows in the lower front opening. The broad woven waist belt has round gold clasps and dangling ornaments. A tan-gold geometric bordered and fringed wrap rests around the forearms and hangs at both sides. A gold bracelet and small earrings accompany the gown; a patterned closed flat shoe is visible. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
